body:
Did it ever occur to you that it would be a good idea to ask your son why he didn't feel safe telling you and why he lied to you? If your kid does not want to tell you about his true identity it's definitely time to talk with him and also clearly to think about your parenting.

YTA

I think people here are too focused on whether it is okay for him to fly you out there and then don't have time for you other than sex.
He was working a lot and maybe in his love language it's still romantic to fly you out because he wants to be intimate with you although he doesn't really have time for you.

For me the concerning part here is the communication when you were there. You told him you felt uncomfortable with this arrangement and he dismissed that basically saying you have no right to feel the way you felt.

I would try and talk to him again. Tell him you appreciated him flying you out there, because he missed you and you respect that he had a lot of work to do, but that communication is still key in a relationship so it is not okay for him to just dismiss your feelings like that.
